2026-10-09DNDNational Defence ActRegulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian ForcesRegulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian Forces in order to add an article to Chapter 112, Section 8, to require that, when a court martial convicts an accused of the hate crime under subsection 320.1001(1) of the Criminal Code, the court martial finding clearly identify the included offence proven by the evidence.N/A
subject: Regulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian Forces
precis: Regulations Amending the Queen's Regulations and Orders for the Canadian Forces in order to add an article to Chapter 112, Section 8, to require that, when a court martial convicts an accused of the hate crime under subsection 320.1001(1) of the Criminal Code, the court martial finding clearly identify the included offence proven by the evidence.
